summary: Executed backend pytest regression (auth/commerce) and frontend Playwright coverage for storefront, bundle checkout, reseller lead, responsive layouts, and admin login.

critical.issue: Valid admin credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md fail with 403 'Request origin not allowed' even when Origin is the public app URL; blocks admin session creation and downstream auth tests.

minor.issue: Could not validate success path because login cookie cannot be established due to origin rejection.
Lockout behavior could not be reached because auth requests are rejected at origin-check stage with 403.

ui_bugs.issue: Valid login shows 'Request origin not allowed' error; admin dashboard inaccessible.
Empty-cart browse CTA did not close drawer in observed run (known risk confirmed once).

integration_issues.issue: Blocked by auth/login 403 origin rejection, so edit/restore flows could not be executed.

issues: Console repeatedly reports duplicate React keys and hydration warning traces while on /shop.

action_items: Fix auth origin validation/config so public frontend origin is accepted for /api/auth/login.
After auth fix, re-test admin login and full admin edit/restore flows (product price, announcement, WhatsApp number, reseller JSON, lead/order status).
Fix cart empty-state CTA to reliably close drawer after navigation.
Investigate and resolve /shop console duplicate-key/hydration warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.check_origin uses strict single-origin equality and currently rejects legitimate production requests; this is a single-point failure for all admin workflows.
Commerce APIs are stable: quote validation, bundle pricing (₹596), enquiry checkout save/idempotency, and lead creation all passed.
Auth storage checks passed for bcrypt format ($2b$) and users.email unique index in Mongo.
seed_data_creation: Created QA TEST leads/orders/enquiries through UI/API tests (non-destructive).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not spend more cycles on cart-remove selector from account overlay; selector interaction became viewport-constrained in drawer. Focus next run on auth-origin fix first, then re-run admin CMS restore scenarios and empty-cart drawer close behavior.
rca of the issue: RCA: Admin auth failure is due to backend origin gate before credential validation. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials and Origin=https://sangley-bhadang.preview.emergentagent.com returns 403 'Request origin not allowed'; same seen from browser UI and pytest. Impact: httpOnly cookies never set, /api/auth/me remains 401, admin area inaccessible. Mitigation: correct FRONTEND_URL runtime value and/or normalize trusted origin matching logic for deployment host variants, then re-run auth and admin flows.
